Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 28

“...the sage whose senses, mind, and understanding are controlled, intent on liberation, free of desire, fear, and anger, is forever free.”

The sentence completes with inner conditions after outer technique. Note the order — Krishna gives the posture first and the freedom last, as its result rather than its price.
